name: Cursed Captain's Chest
description: The fallen captain's chest in the Compass Rose hold (C9). It crashed through the decks and anchors the curse that animates drowned sailors on the island's beaches.
properties: Breaking or dispelling the curse in C8–C9 stops new zombies from rising on the beach. See booklet treasure tables for hold contents.
notes: Chapter 3 finale objective. Source of zombie resurgence if ignored.
